    Warning Signs

    Is Your Property Showing These Signs?

    If you're experiencing any of these issues, it's time to call in the professionals.

    Dripping Faucets

    Constant dripping wastes hundreds of liters daily and significantly inflates DEWA bills.

    Slow Drains

    Sinks, showers, or bathtubs draining very slowly — a clear sign of a blockage.

    Low Water Pressure

    Weak water flow from taps or showerheads affecting daily use and comfort.

    Water Stains on Walls

    Yellow or brown wall stains indicating a concealed, ongoing pipe leak.

    Running Toilet

    Toilet that keeps running after flushing — wasting thousands of liters monthly.

    No Hot Water

    Water heater failure suddenly leaving you without hot water.
